description: Look up an auto insurer's five-digit NAIC code from the California DMV insurance-carrier list by company name. California requires the NAIC number when reporting insurance for a registered vehicle, so this answers "NAIC code for State Farm", "what is Geico's NAIC number", or "insurer codes matching Progressive". The list is California's; NAIC codes themselves are national.

insurer.description: Insurance company name or fragment, e.g. "State Farm", "Geico", "Progressive".

name: ca_dmv_insurance_lookup
